mariadb-c-api-v1.description: MariaDB Connector/C API adaptation; MySQL behavior retained; explicit TLS policies rejected before authentication until qualified; SQL separately gated.

android-arm64-v1.description: Android ARM64 native profile: qualified MariaDB C API policy, portable CPU-affinity diagnostics, fixed-width logging SQL timestamp; gameplay and all52modules preserved.

android-arm64-socket-v2.description: Android ARM64 MariaDB profile plus immutable shared Unix-socket routing and fail-closed numeric port validation; original SQL/updater behavior retained.

android-arm64-resolver-v3.description: Android ARM64 socket profile plus Bionic-supported resolver flags; non-Android resolver behavior, seed rows, eligibility and updater retained.

android-arm64-world-v4.description: Android world compilation profile: v3 auth compatibility plus token-aware Lua warning-flag cleanup; preserves targeted NDK security flags, Lua5.2 static, C++20 and all52 modules.

android-arm64-world-v5.description: Android world compilation profile: v4 Lua warning-token correction plus direct Log.h dependency for Object.h inline logging with precompiled headers disabled; gameplay/C++20/all52 modules preserved.

android-arm64-world-v6.description: Android world compilation profile: v5 Lua/header fixes plus gSOAP GNU strerror_r return handling selected by Bionic __USE_GNU; Android XSI and other platforms unchanged; C++20/all52 modules retained.

android-arm64-world-v7.description: Android world compilation profile: v6 portability fixes plus direct cstddef dependency for botspell.h std::size_t with precompiled headers disabled; no gameplay/type changes; C++20/all52 modules retained.
